prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a single static full-body transparent game-character master proposal, not an animation or a contact sheet.
Primary request: redraw the original Heroes III POWER LICH in input image 1 at high resolution, preserving its exact source idle pose, source-facing direction, skeletal anatomy, slender silhouette, costume and distinctive staff. This is a faithful material/rendering translation of this specific sprite, not a redesign.
Input images: Image 1 is the native idle pose and identity authority. Image 2 is the original idle group guide, with its FIRST figure (G2 F0 / cplich74.pcx) authoritative for the pose and black staff orb. Image 3 is original turn-frame anatomy/costume evidence only; do not take its frontal pose. Image 4 is the approved Pikeman rendering benchmark ONLY: borrow its fine modeled volumes, smooth shaded surfaces, convincing small metallic highlights and textured material definition, never its human anatomy, equipment, blue/white colors, facial features or left-facing pose.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background and transparent negative spaces. Isolated character and its one staff only.
Subject and pose: a tall, very slim undead skeletal lich standing in the SAME restrained idle pose as image 1, skull and body oriented toward image RIGHT in a slight three-quarter side view. The crown and skull face right, both feet remain visible at the hem, with one foot pointing forward to the right. The visible rear arm on the image LEFT hangs down with its long bony hand open beside the hip; the other skeletal hand at image RIGHT grips the slim, almost vertical staff at lower-chest height. Staff is held to the right of the body; its foot ends near the feet and its horned finial rises a little above the crown. No action pose, no walking stride.
Identity and materials: clearly bare pale grey-green bone in the skull, jaw, arms and fingers, no human flesh. Preserve the tall gold-and-black crowned headpiece with its broad upright gold-edged points and small muted red insets, the dark fitted mail coif/neck covering underneath, narrow dark armored torso, modest pointed shoulder armor, gold piping and crossing gold-edged chest bands, fitted gold-edged waist armor. Preserve the extensive ankle-length dark iron chainmail skirt: dense fine linked-metal texture, restrained cool silver glints, narrow silhouette slightly flared at the gold-edged hem, not flowing cloth. Keep the dark metal armor fitted, not bulky. Small gold accents frame the dark grey/black costume.
Staff: preserve the original narrow straight dark brown/black shaft with restrained gold fittings, gold lower ferrule, and distinctive gold U-shaped crescent/horn finial cupping ONE glossy black orb. The two upward curving horns cradle the orb, with the small downward split gold prongs directly beneath the crescent, as in image 1. Do not substitute a plain CLICH staff, crooked wood, scythe, spear, skull-topped staff, cross, or an invented large ornament. Black idle orb has a small surface highlight, not a glowing red spell effect.
Style/medium: carefully modeled textured fantasy game-character render matching image 4's polish. Fine controlled shading describes bone, dark metal, chainmail and gold as distinct materials. Preserve the original's narrow proportions and compact readable details. No block-pixel filter or enlarged pixel clusters.
Composition: one complete figure, crown, staff horns, shaft tip, hands and both feet fully inside the frame, with generous transparent margins on every side. Portrait framing, figure occupies most of the height without cropping. No reference panels.
Constraints: preserve original proportions, exact idle arrangement, right-facing orientation and source-specific Power Lich identity. No hooded wizard, flesh monk, robes replacing the chainmail, extra weapons, extra limbs, giant shoulder plates, chibi proportions, theatrical cloak, flames, smoke, aura, spell particles, floor, pedestal, floor shadow, text, border, labels, logo or watermark. Render only the finished transparent cutout.
